definitions.explanation: A professional dancer, particularly one trained in traditional Japanese dance or classical/contemporary dance forms. The suffix {家|か} indicates a professional or expert in the field.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧な{舞踊家|ぶようか}だ。
⟦{日本舞踊|にほんぶよう}→日本舞踊：28381_nihonbuyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{舞踊家|ぶようか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{舞台|ぶたい}→舞台：03606_butai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{踊|おど}った→踊る：01250_odoru⟧。
examples.english: A Japanese dance artist performed on stage.

examples.japanese: {若|わか}い{頃|ころ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{舞踊家|ぶようか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{目指|めざ}して→目指す：10528_mezasu⟧⟦{厳|きび}しい→厳しい：01125_kibishii⟧⟦{稽古|けいこ}→稽古：00210_keiko⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{続|つづ}け→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧てきた。
examples.english: She has continued rigorous training since a young age, aiming to become a dancer.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{舞踊|ぶよう}→舞踊：05410_buyou⟧ (dance, dancing) + ⟦{家|か}→〜家：28339_ka⟧ (professional, expert). Refers to a serious, professional dancer rather than a casual or recreational one. Carries a more formal and artistic connotation than ⟦ダンサー→ダンサー：08801_dansaa⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{日本舞踊|にほんぶよう}→日本舞踊：28381_nihonbuyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{舞踊家|ぶようか}: Japanese traditional dance artist
- ⟦バレエ→バレエ：06504_baree⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{舞踊家|ぶようか}: ballet dancer
- {舞踊家|ぶようか}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{活躍|かつやく}する→活躍する：25354_katsuyakusuru⟧: to be active as a dancer
- {舞踊家|ぶようか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{目指|めざ}す→目指す：10528_mezasu⟧: to aspire to become a dancer

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ダンサー→ダンサー：08801_dansaa⟧: dancer — loanword; used broadly for all styles, especially modern and Western dance
- {踊|おど}り{手|て}: dancer — native word; often for folk or traditional dance
- ⟦{振付師|ふりつけし}→振付師：17990_furitsukeshi⟧: choreographer — focuses on creating dance movements
